title: Limits of Satan’s Power
definition: Limits of Satan’s Power refers to the biblical teaching about evil spiritual opposition.
summary: Limits of Satan’s Power refers to the biblical teaching about evil spiritual opposition.
christFocus: Christ triumphs over every evil power and protects His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Limits of Satan’s Power recognizes spiritual reality while keeping God, not the spiritual realm, at the center. Darkness is real, deceptive, and destructive, but it is not sovereign.

Scripture speaks soberly about angels, demons, Satan, and unseen conflict, but it refuses fear, obsession, and speculation. Fear, accusation, bondage, and deception can feel overwhelming to vulnerable believers.

Christ is supreme over every spiritual being and power. Christ triumphs over every evil power and protects His people. Believers stand in His victory through Scripture, prayer, faith, and the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Spiritual reality affects real life, but Scripture keeps the believer from fear and fascination. Fear, accusation, bondage, and deception can feel overwhelming to vulnerable believers. The unseen realm must be understood under the rule of God and the victory of Christ.

It also protects against spiritual confusion. Angels are servants, demons are defeated enemies, Satan is limited, and Christ alone is worthy of trust and worship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Resist evil by standing in Christ and Scripture. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
